column2: step 5c publish gates check only `.completed/step-5b`, not `.completed/step-5b.5`. an orchestrator bug, resume mis-route, pause/resume race, or direct cli invocation can reach `design step5c` / `design publish` after oos filing (or gate c approval) but before post-approval diagram work completes. that can publish `[designed]`, upsert the plan, and rename the issue without running or completing step 5b.5, violating requirement 1 (diagram only after approval) and the skill invariant blocking step 5c before the 5b.5 sentinel.

step 2b anti-halt continue lines still promise "diagram generation" during the step 3 path. after relocation, diagram work happens only post–gate c approve at 5b.5; stale text can cause the orchestrator to treat pre-gate-c paths as diagram-complete or skip 5b.5.

issue requires /implement diagrams stay off chat; plan only adds a harness assertion and leaves `diagrams` in the preserved verbosity list. an orchestrator following skill verbosity may still emit code-flow diagram bodies to chat even though step 7a helpers do not; issue item 2 is only half-delivered.

rejected or missing post-approval diagram does not create a clear marker. if diagram generation fails before a candidate or sanitizer rejects it, the sanitizer deletes diagram files and completes the step; publish then sees neither `architecture-diagram.md` nor `architecture-diagram.skipped`, so stale `larch:diagrams` architecture content can remain.

the current step 3b failure path appends full generation failure capture to `execution-issues.md` via `run-log append-failure` (skill.md line 724). if step 5b.5 keeps that pattern, partial mermaid output from a failed generator could be published with the design run log, contradicting the scope goal that diagrams should not flush to run logs.

python/design_publish.py:320-337 [scope-reduction] finding_6 adds a third publish branch that clears architecture when `.completed/step-5b.5` exists but neither `architecture-diagram.md` nor `architecture-diagram.skipped` is present. scenario: if an accepted `architecture-diagram.md` is lost from `$design_tmpdir` after sanitization but before publish, step 5c may call `--clear-architecture` and wipe a valid issue diagram even though the run intended to upsert one

the plan targets diagram chat/run-log exclusion for `/design` but does not stop `/implement` diagram failure captures from landing in committed run logs. `_copy_diagram_failure_log` in `python/step_7a.py` still copies `code-flow-diagram.failure.log` into `larch-logs/implement/<run_id>/`, and `python/pr_body.py` writes generator stdout/stderr (which may contain partial mermaid) to that failure log on non-zero exit. `python/test_step_7a.py` asserts the copy. this violates the scope requirement that diagram content not be flushed to run logs.

the plan adds `architecture-diagram-generation.failure.log` to top-level publish exclusions in `python/design_log_publish_flow.py` but not `architecture-diagram-sanitizer.failure.log`. `skills/design/scripts/design-step3b-sanitize.sh` still writes full sanitizer output to that basename on fail-closed paths, and it is not matched by `_publish_exclude_suffixes`. sanitizer rejection after the relocated step 5b.5 can still commit mermaid-bearing failure captures to design run logs despite the no-diagram-in-logs goal.
